cases.question: 本月支付订单群截至查询时的已完成模拟退款订单率是多少？保留百分比两位。

cases.reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) AS DECIMAL) / NULLIF(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS DECIMAL), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS refund_rate_percent FROM public.orders AS o LEFT JOIN public.refund_requests AS r ON r.order_id = o.id AND r.status = 'completed_simulated' WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND CAST((o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS DATE) >= CAST('2026-10-01' AS DATE) AND CAST((o.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Shanghai') AS DATE) < CAST('2026-10-13' AS DATE) LIMIT 501
